newsitem.title: JAPAN: Teikoku Oil obtains interest in Gulf of Suez field.
newsitem.headline: Teikoku Oil obtains interest in Gulf of Suez field.

text.p: Teikoku Oil Co Ltd said on Thursday that one of its subsidiaries had obtained from an Agip SpA unit a 40 percent participating interest in a concession in the southern Gulf of Suez.
The agreement, worth $9.16 million, was signed between the Japanese company and International Egyptian Oil Company (IEOC) in Cairo on Wednesday, a Teikoku Oil official said.
IEOC, an Egyptian subsidiary of Agip, was awarded the concession in May in a tender by state-owned Egyptian General Petroleum Corp (EGPC), the official said.
The 67-square-km concession is about four km offshore from Zeit Bay in the southern Gulf.
The agreement sets an exploration term of eight years, with total exploration costs in the first four years expected to total about $20 million, Teikoku said.
